name: tsa_createOrder
description: Creates the worker's meal order for today (UTC date) and returns its QR token. Idempotent per worker per day: if TSA.Order already has a row for (workerId, today) the existing token is returned unchanged, even when a different restaurant or meal was chosen. @workerId comes from the worker session the Next.js route validated (tsa_validateSession). Called by the TSA Eats Next.js app (tsa-eats/lib/api.ts) through api/Endpoints/TsaApi.cs, which maps queryType 'createOrder' to [TSA].[tsa_createOrder]. There is no Harrier Central auth: POST requires the shared X-Api-Key (TsaApiKey); GET requires nothing, and the shim does not restrict which procedure a GET may name. The shim turns any one-row rowset with Success = 0 into HTTP 400 {success:false, errorMessage}, and an empty first rowset into HTTP 404.

parameters.name: workerId
parameters.description: Worker placing the order, from the validated session. No default.

parameters.name: restaurantId
parameters.description: Restaurant chosen. Not checked for isActive. No default.

parameters.name: mealId
parameters.description: TSA.MenuItem chosen. Not checked against @restaurantId or isAvailable. No default.

rowsets.name: OrderResult
rowsets.description: Always exactly one rowset of one row: success (new or existing order) or the CATCH error.

columns.name: token
columns.description: Order QR token; the existing token when the worker already ordered today; NULL on error.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: NULL on success; ERROR_MESSAGE() on error.

sideEffects: INSERT TSA.Order (one row) when the worker has no order for today's UTC date.

codeSmells.detail: @workerId, @restaurantId, @mealId (lines 2-4) have no SQL default. A caller that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the body runs: no log row, and the TsaApi shim returns a generic 500.
The CATCH (lines 46-49) returns the error envelope but writes nothing to HC.ErrorLog or any TSA log table, so failures are only visible in Azure Function logs as a 400 warning.

codeSmells.issue: Check-then-INSERT on a UNIQUE key without UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK
codeSmells.detail: Lines 27-29 read TSA.Order without (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) before the INSERT at line 40. A double tap races both past the check; the second INSERT violates UQ_TSA_Order_Worker_Date and the user sees the raw SQL message as a 400 instead of their existing token.
Line 23 uses CAST(GETUTCDATE() AS DATE). For US workers the UTC date rolls at 19:00-20:00 local, so an evening order lands on tomorrow's date (and tsa_redeemOrder applies the same UTC test).

No check that @mealId belongs to @restaurantId, that the item isAvailable, that the restaurant isActive, or that MenuItem/Restaurant dailyQuota is not exceeded; dailyQuota is never enforced by any TSA procedure.
The header (line 15) documents Success as SMALLINT; the literal 1/0 is INT.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
